# Original synthetic fixture resources

The three files listed in manifest.json were authored solely for these contract
tests on 16 November 2026. The original fixture material in this namespace is
dedicated under CC0-1.0. There are no third-party media or model assets.

chart.png is an original abstract 2x2 pixel grid, not a portrait. tide-card.txt is
original fictional text, not navigation advice. cue.wav is an original synthetic
0.1-second 440 Hz mono 8000 Hz PCM tone, not spoken text or a voice reference.
Audio/text matching and generated voice or portrait quality are not claimed.

Existing imported contract modules and the separate T15 Emma test control retain
their own repository notices/provenance; this notice does not relicense them.
